install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; if ! [ -x "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" ] || ! "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" --list-sdks 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^11\.0\.'; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.dotnet"; curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash -s -- --channel 11.0 --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet" --no-path; fi; grep -qxF 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" --list-sdks | grep -q '^11\.0\.'
